DRG1.basis: Full Val-rep official-score comparison with archived E0
DRG1.reference: fe10d7b E0 (same archived wave1 ensemble_bias scores)

DRG2.method: Check each saved clean/stress image/K cumulative core hook count; sum maximum K once per trajectory for actual calls.

DRG3.definition: L2/Frobenius norm of the 16x16x1x1 gate weight at each selected best.pt, CPU double precision; no model forward performed.
DRG3.limitation: Nonzero gates and the enabled forward path establish the specified trained-branch check. No gate-zero ablation or causal effect attribution was run.

DR-P3.status: MET by the specified mean-difference comparison
DR-P3.interpretation: Both domain deltas are reported with their signs; a larger difference does not imply positive improvement.

DR-R2.outcome: Do not add detail heads by default for directions 3/4

limitations: Per-domain Val-sel L was not saved; per-seed selection values are Overall only.
No new inference, gate-zero ablation, or causal component attribution was performed.
DR-P3 is evaluated using the specified mean-difference comparison, retaining both signs to distinguish smaller decline from positive improvement.

component_decomposition.method: Apply official linear quality weights to saved per-K component differences and L weights. This is score-difference arithmetic, not a new image metric implementation or causal ablation.
